findings.claim: Section 3.3's interactive states ('附註輸入', 'o 看全部', '送出預覽') and single-row option overflow rules exceed ctrlCap at small heights (L4 H = 5, L3 H = 7) or omit required clickable ('press') specifications asserted by Section 5's R1-lower tests.
findings.evidence: In L2/L3/L4 normal state, note and submit share 1 merged row, but Section 3.3 defines '附註輸入' as keeping '選項列' (1 row) plus '輸入列' (1 row) plus 'Enter 確定 · Esc 取消' (1 row) = 3 rows in L4 (ctrlCap = 2 at H = 5) and 4 rows with the switcher in L3 (ctrlCap = 3 at H = 7), exceeding ctrlCap. For 'o 看全部', Section 3.3 says the option list '暫時取代換卡器的位置（仍在控制區內，列數不超過 ctrlCap），Esc 收回', yet L4 has 0 switcher rows ('不顯示') and ctrlCap - 1 = 1 row cannot display overflowed 4-option lists like '[D, C, B, A]'. Section 5 mandates R1-lower assertions across '附註輸入', '送出預覽', and 'o 看全部' plus 'key:a' in every size, but Section 3.3 omits 'o 看全部' and 'key:o' from its press spec, omits whether '附註列' is replaced during '送出預覽' (keeping it yields ctrlCap + 1 rows), and provides no per-option width cap or R1-lower rule when 'key:a' is collapsed inside '… 另 N 項 · o 看全部' (as in Section 5's '[D, C, B, A]' case where only 'key:d' and 'key:c' fit).
findings.repair: Specify ctrlCap-safe layouts and explicit press contracts for all three non-default states: (1) in '附註輸入' when ctrlCap <= 3, temporarily hide the switcher (L3) and merge or replace the options row at ctrlCap == 2 so '輸入列' + 'Enter 確定 · Esc 取消' ('key:enter', 'key:esc') fit within 2 rows; (2) in '送出預覽', explicitly replace switcher, options, and note rows with up to ctrlCap - 1 preview rows plus '[y] 確定送出 · Esc 回去' ('key:y', 'key:esc'); (3) in 'o 看全部', pack multiple options per row or page within ctrlCap - 1 rows plus 'Esc 收回' ('key:esc') and include 'key:o' when collapsed; and (4) cap per-option display width in L3/L4 so at least one option plus 'o 看全部' always fits in 80 cols, updating R1-lower to assert visible option keys ('key:<letter>') plus 'key:o' when 'a' is among collapsed trailing options.
findings.failure_scenario: In boxed 80x24 (H = 5, ctrlCap = 2, L4), Section 5's R1-lower input-state test triggers '附註輸入' ('m'). Following Section 3.3 ('附註列變成輸入列，選項列保留；送出列改成 Enter 確定 · Esc 取消'), decide.ts emits 3 control rows against ctrlCap = 2, immediately throwing frame.ts's dev-mode assertion ('控制區列數大於 ctrlCap 也丟錯').
findings.recheck_reason: L3 附註輸入仍未明定隱藏換卡器，可能需四列而超過容量三列；亦未保證長選項與可點的 o 看全部能同列容納。

findings.claim: Section 4 freezes mocks as immutable ('不取代 mock') while omitting 5-9 required side-by-side mocks, embedding wrong row counts, ctrlCap values, and L2 row structure in the mocks/prose it does provide, and exposing a conflict between Section 3.1 top-down frame truncation and Section 3.2 middle truncation.
findings.evidence: Section 1.5 and Section 5 require screenshots across 3 sizes x docked/boxed for both decide and forge pages (12 cells); Section 4 lists 8 cells and draws only 3 ASCII mocks (omitting boxed H = 17 despite claiming 'boxed 三種高度各畫一張', docked 80x24/200x50, and all forge mocks). Inside Section 4: (a) the 'boxed H＝13（L2，ctrlCap 5）' mock has 12 total rows (not 13), writes ctrlCap 5 (ceil(13/2) - 1 = 6 in Section 3.3), splits 'm 附註' and '[s] 送出' onto 2 rows (contradicting L2's merged 'm 附註 · [s] 送出 N 張'), omits pinned item 1 ('待決 6 張 · 第 3 張'), and places '建議' above '↑ 背景 2 列'; (b) prose writes ctrlCap 7 for H = 17 (vs 8) and ctrlCap 11/24 for docked 80x24/200x50 (vs 10/23) plus an unlisted '… 另 N 張' row in L0; (c) docked 120x40 draws a 19-row box truncating 12 background rows even though 120x40 has ~38 rows; and (d) Section 3.1 truncates info from the very top ('從資訊區最上面開始截'), which cuts off Section 3.2's pinned item 1 ('分類標題：釘住，永遠不被截'), while Section 3.2's '分類標題和第 6 項不截' (2+ rows) cannot fit in H = 5's 1-row info area.
findings.repair: Align the screenshot/mock matrix count across Sections 1.5, 4, and 5 and draw valid baseline mocks for every required cell before freezing (including boxed H = 17 C two-column and forge pages). Fix boxed H = 13 to 13 rows with ctrlCap = 6, merged L2 'm 附註 · [s] 送出', and Section 3.2's exact row order; fix ctrlCap numbers in Section 4 prose (8 for H = 17, 10/23 or exact formula for docked); pass ctx.infoCap = maxRows - 2 - C so decide.ts performs middle-truncation of '背景' instead of frame cutting pinned top rows; and define an explicit truncation order when infoCap < 2 (such as H = 5, specifying whether card title moves to the top border and item 6 or item 5 fills the 1 info row).
findings.failure_scenario: In U5, when comparing real terminal screenshots side-by-side against Section 4 without replacing Section 4's mocks ('不取代 mock'), boxed H = 17 and all forge cells have no ASCII mock to pair with, and boxed H = 13's real 13-row L2 output (1 merged m+s row, pinned header at row 1) disagrees on row count, ctrlCap, info ordering, and control-row count with Section 4's 12-row mock.
